name: Blue Professional
avoid_for: Contexts where the deck should feel hot, playful, or intentionally informal — the cool electric-blue restraint will read as overly polished
weak_cases: Single-hue charts need labels or another encoding for multiple categories; never invent metrics to fill panels.
visual_signature: Soft cobalt surfaces, rounded tinted panels and restrained sans hierarchy.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Sans roles can be adapted across scripts; named Latin faces do not establish coverage.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
